entities.summary: Euronext Paris, formerly known as the Paris Bourse, is a regulated securities trading venue in France. It is Europe's second largest stock exchange by market capitalization, behind the London Stock Exchange, as of December 2023. As of 2022, the 795 companies listed had a combined market capitalization of over US$4.58 trillion. Euronext Paris is a stock exchange in Paris, established in 1724-09-24. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
